(Hesperia, California) | college = [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]] (2019–2022) | draftyear = 2022 | career_start = 2022 | career_end = | years1 = [[2022–23 NBA G League season|2022]]–[[2023–24 NBA G League season|2024]] | team1 = [[Oklahoma City Blue]] | years2 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024]]–[[2025–26 NBA G League season|2026]] | team2 = [[Valley Suns]] | years3 = 2026 | team3 = [[CB San Pablo Burgos|San Pablo Burgos]] | highlights = * [[List of NBA G League champions|NBA G League champion]] ([[2023–24 NBA G League season|2024]]) * Second-team All SEC (2022) * Second-team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] – Coaches (2021) * SEC All-Freshman Team (2020) }} '''Jaden Shackelford''' (born February 14, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[CB San Pablo Burgos|San Pablo Burgos]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama Crimson Tide]]. ==High school career== In his first two years of high school, Shackelford attended Oak Hills High School in [[Oak Hills, San Bernardino County, California|Oak Hills, California]].{{cite web |last1=Hall |first1=Erik |title=Jaden Shackelford: 3 things to know about the Alabama men's basketball guard |url=https://www.tuscaloosanews.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2021/01/16/jaden-shackelford-5-facts-alabama-mens-basketball-guard/4189889001/ |website=[[The Tuscaloosa News]] |access-date=March 2, 2021 |date=January 16, 2021}} For his junior season, he transferred to [[Hesperia High School]] in [[Hesperia, California]].{{cite web |last1=Murphy |first1=John |title=Inland Boys Basketball Preview: Jaden Shackelford ready to roll at Hesperia |url=https://www.dailybulletin.com/2018/11/13/boys-basketball-preview-jaden-shackelford-ready-to-roll-at-hesperia/ |website=[[Inland Valley Daily Bulletin]] |access-date=March 2, 2021 |date=November 13, 2018}} Shackelford averaged 34 points, 11 rebounds, 5.5 assists and four steals per game as a senior. He was named [[Mojave River League]] MVP and ''[[Daily Press (California)|Daily Press]]'' Basketball Athlete of the Year.{{cite web |last1=Quintero |first1=Jose |title=Hesperia's Jaden Shackelford, Alabama teammates 'bummed' about canceled season |url=https://www.vvdailypress.com/sports/20200313/hesperias-jaden-shackelford-alabama-teammates-bummed-about-canceled-season |website=[[Daily Press (California)|Daily Press]] |access-date=March 2, 2021 |date=March 13, 2020 |archive-date=October 25, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201025083826/https://www.vvdailypress.com/sports/20200313/hesperias-jaden-shackelford-alabama-teammates-bummed-about-canceled-season |url-status=dead }} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]] over offers from [[Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball|Kansas State]], [[Pepperdine Waves men's basketball|Pepperdine]] and [[UNLV Runnin' Rebels basketball|UNLV]], among others.{{cite web |title=Jaden Shackelford commits to Alabama men's basketball |url=https://www.tuscaloosanews.com/news/20180930/jaden-shackelford-commits-to-alabama-mens-basketball |website=[[The Tuscaloosa News]] |access-date=March 2, 2021 |date=September 30, 2018}} ==College career== On February 12, 2020, Shackelford matched his freshman season-high of 28 points, with eight rebounds and seven three-pointers, in a 95–91 loss to [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]] in overtime.{{cite web |last1=Goodman |first1=Joseph |title=Stunning Jaden Shackelford pointing Alabama basketball in right direction |url=https://www.al.com/alabamabasketball/2020/03/stunning-jaden-shackelford-pointing-alabama-basketball-in-right-direction.html |website=AL.com |access-date=March 2, 2021 |date=March 3, 2020}} Six days later, he was named USBWA National Freshman of the Week.{{cite web |last1=Martin |first1=Tyler |title=Jaden Shackelford Earns National Freshman of the Week Honors |url=https://www.si.com/college/alabama/bamacentral/alabama-basketball-jaden-shackelford-national-freshman-of-the-week |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |access-date=March 2, 2021 |date=February 18, 2020}} As a freshman, Shackelford averaged 15 points and 4.5 rebounds per game, earning [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] All-Freshman Team honors. He averaged 14 points, 3.8 rebounds, and 2 assists per game as a sophomore. Shackelford was named to the Second Team All-SEC. Following the season he entered the [[2021 NBA draft]] without hiring an agent, and also entered the transfer portal.{{cite news |last1=Potter |first1=Charlie |title=Alabama's Jaden Shackelford plans to enter transfer portal, per report |url=https://247sports.com/college/alabama/Article/Alabama-Crimson-Tide-Basketball-Jaden-Shackelford-plans-to-enter-transfer-portal-per-report-167252241/ |access-date=July 2, 2021 |work=247 Sports |date=June 30, 2021}} Shackelford decided to return to Alabama in July 2021.{{cite news |last1=Rodak |first1=Mike |title=Jaden Shackelford returning to Alabama after exploring transfer |url=https://www.al.com/alabamabasketball/2021/07/jaden-shackelford-returning-to-alabama-after-exploring-transfer.html |access-date=September 19, 2021 |work=AL.com |date=July 20, 2021}} On February 9, 2022, he posted career-highs of 30 points and eight 3-pointers in a 97–83 win over [[Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball|Ole Miss]].{{cite news |title=Shackelford has 8 of Tide's 14 3s in 97-83 win over Ole Miss |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401364923 |access-date=February 11, 2022 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=February 9, 2022}} Shackelford was named to the Second Team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] as a junior after averaging 16.6 points and 5.4 rebounds per game.{{cite news |last1=Montgomery |first1=Charles |title=Four Alabama men’s basketball players earn SEC All-Conference honors |url=https://www.waff.com/2022/03/08/four-alabama-mens-basketball-players-earn-sec-all-conference-honors/ |access-date=March 19, 2022 |work=WAFF |date=March 8, 2022}} On April 3, 2022, Shackelford declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]], forgoing his remaining college eligibility.{{cite web|title=Alabama junior guard Jaden Shackelford declares for 2022 NBA Draft|url=https://247sports.com/college/alabama/Article/Alabama-Basketball-junior-guard-Jaden-Shackelford-declares-for-2022-NBA-Draft-185682543/|first=Charlie|last=Potter|date=April 3, 2022|accessdate=April 5, 2022}} ==Professional career== ===Oklahoma City Blue (2022–2024)=== After going undrafted in the 2022 NBA draft, Shackelford signed an [[Exhibit 10]] contract with the Oklahoma City Thunder on June 24, 2022.{{cite news|first=Katie|last=Windham|title=Jaden Shackelford Signs Deal with Oklahoma City Thunder|url=https://www.si.com/college/alabama/bamacentral/jaden-shackelford-signs-deal-with-oklahoma-city-thunder|website=SI.com|publisher=[[FanNation]]|date=June 24, 2022|access-date=July 16, 2022}} On November 3, 2022, Shackelford was named to the opening night roster for the [[Oklahoma City Blue]].{{cite web|title=Oklahoma City Blue Roster 2022-23|url=https://oklahomacity.gleague.nba.com/roster|website=NBA.com|date=November 3, 2022|access-date=November 3, 2022}} On October 20, 2023, Shackelford signed with the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]], but was waived the same day.{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Thunder Sign, Waive Jahmi’us Ramsey, Jaden Shackelford|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/10/thunder-sign-jahmius-ramsey-jaden-shackelford.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 20, 2023|access-date=October 22, 2023}} On October 31, he re-joined the [[Oklahoma City Blue]].{{cite tweet|author=OKC BLUE|title=Let’s work 🫡 2023-24 #OKCBlue Training Camp Roster🔵|number=1719380343176716560|user=okcblue|date=October 31, 2023|access-date=November 21, 2023}} During his second season with them, Shackelford would win the 2024 NBA G League championship while with the Blue. ===Valley Suns (2024–2026)=== On September 19, 2024, Shackelford signed an Exhibit 10 deal with the [[Phoenix Suns]],{{cite web|first=Rory|last=Maher|title=Suns Sign Jaden Shackelford To Exhibit 10 Deal|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/09/suns-to-sign-jaden-shackelford-to-exhibit-10-deal.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 19, 2024|access-date=September 20, 2024}} but was waived on September 26.{{cite web|first=Alex|last=Kirschenbaum|title=Suns Cut Tyrese Samuel, Jaden Shackelford|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/09/suns-cut-tyrese-samuel-jaden-shackelford.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 26, 2024|access-date=October 27, 2024}} On October 27, he joined the [[Valley Suns]].{{cite web|title=Valley Suns Announce 2024-25 Training Camp Roster|url=https://valley.gleague.nba.com/news/valley-suns-announce-2024-25-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 27, 2024|access-date=October 31, 2024}} ===San Pablo Burgos (2026–present)=== On September 19, 2024, Shackelford signed for [[CB San Pablo Burgos|San Pablo Burgos]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]].{{cite web|title=El potencial anotador de Jaden Shackelford llega a Burgos|url=https://acb.com/es/liga/noticias/el-potencial-anotador-de-jaden-shackelford-llega-a-burgos-144768|website=acb.com|date=April 2, 2026|access-date=April 2, 2026|language=es}} ==Career
